items.title: AI isn’t close to curing cancer. This startup says it knows what it will take.
items.summary: It's the data, stupid.

items.title: You can Venmo your college tuition, for some reason
items.summary: Kids these days don't know how good they have it.

items.title: Relativity Networks raises $22 million to bring a faster kind of fiber to data centers
items.summary: Relativity Networks deals in hollow-core fiber, a rarely deployed technology that allows data to be transmitted 30% faster than conventional fiber.

items.title: Cursor capitalizes on GitHub frustration, launches rival hosting platform
items.summary: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to rival developers' long preferred favorite, GitHub.

items.title: DOJ’s probe into Andreessen Horowitz over board seats baffles VCs
items.summary: Since portfolio companies often pivot and expand into competing markets, investors view occasional conflicts of interest as unavoidable for large VC firms.

items.title: TikTok explores peer-to-peer payments via DMs, report says
items.summary: If rolled out, the feature would use the social media service’s TikTok Pay offering, which is already available in Southeast Asia for TikTok Shop purchases.

items.title: OpenAI institutes new safeguards after Hugging Face breach
items.summary: The new safeguards include more detailed monitoring of models during the development process, as well as greater emphasis on alignment and security during the post-training process.

items.title: Save up to $300 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 pass until August 21
items.summary: If you’ve been circling around Disrupt, then now’s the best time to lock in your pass and start getting ready to join the rest of the startup community gathering in San Francisco from October 13-15 at Moscone West!

items.title: Etched’s valuation doubles to $21B in a month
items.summary: Jane Street has installed Etched's first shipped AI cluster system, and was so impressed, it led another massive round, the startup says.

items.title: Apple overhauls its EU App Store fees, loosens rules for alternative app stores
items.summary: Apple is simplifying its EU App Store fees, replacing its per-install fee with a 5% commission for apps distributed outside the App Store and making it easier for developers to operate alternative app marketplaces.

items.title: Comcast adds motion sensing to millions of its newer routers, with a privacy catch
items.summary: A new feature added to Comcast's newest routers can detect if there is motion inside your home without needing traditional motion sensors.

items.title: Why Apple’s camera-equipped AirPods may not be the ‘pervert pods’ consumers fear
items.summary: Apple’s leaked camera-equipped AirPods might avoid the privacy pitfalls of other AI wearables by preventing users from recording photos and videos.

items.title: Bluesky says its recent outage was caused by another DDoS attack
items.summary: This is the latest large-scale DDoS attack to hit the social networking site this year.

items.title: Peacock is raising prices across all of its streaming plans
items.summary: "These price changes allow Peacock to continue to create the best experience for its viewers, remain competitive in the marketplace, and deliver unique content across all genres," the company wrote on a support page.

items.title: Anthro Energy breaks ground on factory that could pave the road to solid-state batteries
items.summary: Battery materials startup Anthro Energy has broken ground on a Louisville factory to make electrolytes, including those for solid-state batteries.

items.title: Warp’s new system is an out-of-the-box software factory for AI development
items.summary: On Tuesday, Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastructure system designed to make building AI software factories as easy as possible.

items.title: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
items.summary: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework.

items.title: Perplexity’s free AI offer left it with millions more users in India
items.summary: Perplexity's India revenue rose about 60% after the Airtel offer ended for new users, even as downloads declined.

items.title: Apple’s new macOS update reportedly contains a video of AirPods with a camera
items.summary: A video in a macOS Tahoe release candidate version shows a user wearing AirPods, looking at a book, and talking to Siri.

items.title: Daniel Ek’s body-scanning startup Neko Health opens first US office, in New York
items.summary: The scanning and bloodwork health startup founded by Spotify's founder will officially launch in New York in about a month.
